package.name: Blackjack
package.description: Play Blackjack against the house with Conversation characters. Install to use /blackjack manually in any Conversation chat, or type a message like "let's play blackjack" to open the table setup. Where Chat Settings → Agents → Commands lists Blackjack, characters can start a game while its switch is on.
